roleZh: 在芯片栅极、Kelvin 源极焊盘与信号引出之间建立连接。
roleEn: Connects die gate and Kelvin-source pads to signal leads.
featuresZh: 细线只示意信号连接，主功率连接由母排承担；线弧与焊点可靠性需验证。
featuresEn: Fine wires represent signal connections; busbars carry main power current. Wire loops and bond reliability require validation.
materialZh: 铝线（示意直径 0.3 mm）；实际尺寸视工艺而定。
materialEn: Aluminium wire, illustrated at 0.3 mm diameter; actual dimensions depend on the process.
